title: Catgogo
tagline: PokemonGo for Cats, Catgogo is your go to for cat lover that loves taking photos of cats.
description:
Catgogo connects cats via NFC-NFT to cat lovers. Cats are a huge thing in Taiwan with districts prominently showcasing the cats most famous in their area. There's even a village in Houtong named "Cat Village" which is populated with many cats and many tourist and cat lovers alike flock to the area to interact and take photos with the cats.
Catgogo hopes to push forth the interactions by tagging each cat with a NFC-NFT tag which allows the cats to have it's own digital presence. Cat lovers who often interact and take photos with cats can tap the NFC tag on the cats to gain more details of the cats and also upload the photos they have taken of the cat to increase it's own social presence on Catgogo.
The uploaded photos are shown in a social media/instagram format for other cat lovers to find the cat they like to interact with them too.
With a map view, you are able to see bubbles of the cats photos that are the most popular around the region and cat lover can track and increase the presence of the cats through their interactions.
For cat lover they also gain a token minted through the interaction with the cat showcasing their dedication for cats and storing a history of cats they have interacted.
The photos and data collect through the interaction allow cats to have it's own historical photo gallery and helps track its presence of where it goes.
A win win for managing cat populations and increasing the mobility of cat lovers.

*Sadly tho the idea is great, I don't have the technical capabilities to get it working. Apologies to all cat lovers.
how_its_made:
Using React as the base of the frontend.
ARX as the means to interact with the ARX Chips which allows signing.
World ID to verify and real humans interacting with the cats, this prevents people from abusing the cats and the system as they are verified as a real human.
Polygon SDK to create real world assets of cats
Nodit to subscribe for real time event notifications for users nearby to get alert of cat updates.
